title: Touchpoint Response Latency by Channel
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=touchpoint:log
| search response_delay_hr=*
| stats avg(response_delay_hr) as avg_response_delay_hr perc90(response_delay_hr) as p90_response_delay_hr count as samples by channel
| sort 0 - avg_response_delay_hr
description: Measures touchpoint response latency by channel.
value: Latency by channel shows whether one communication method is quietly becoming too slow to feel connecting.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for touchpoint response latency to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 touchpoint response latency.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how long touchpoint response latency usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
